```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(psych)
library(nFactors)

```



```{r stuff}

# enter correlation matrix values row-by-row
matrix_data <-c(1.00, .560, .480, .224, .192,.160,
                .560, 1.00, .420, .196, .168, .140,
                .480, .420, 1.00, .168, .144,.120,
                .224, .196, .168, 1.00, .420, .350,
                .192, .168, .144, .420, 1.00, .300,
                .160,.140, .120, .350, .300, 1.00)

# make a 6x6 matrix
cor_matrix <-matrix(matrix_data, nrow = 6, ncol = 6, byrow =TRUE)
colnames(cor_matrix) <-rownames(cor_matrix) <- c("Var1", "Var2", "Var3", 
                                                   "Var4", "Var5", "Var6")
print(cor_matrix)



#calculates the determinant of x
det(cor_matrix)

#Calculates Bartlett's test
cortest.bartlett(cor_matrix, n=100)

#Calculates Eigenvalues of the correlations of x
ev<-eigen(cor_matrix)
#conducts parallel analysis and creates an object
newap<-parallel(subject=nrow(cor_matrix),var=ncol(cor_matrix),rep=100,cent=.05)
# conducts screeplot and creates an object
nS<-nScree(x=ev$values, aparallel = newap$eigen$qevpea)
#plots the scree plot
plotnScree(nS)


#creates new object call fit that is a Factor Analysis

fit<-fa(cor_matrix, rotate = "oblimin", fm = 'ml')
#displays results
fit

fit2<-fa(cor_matrix, nfactors = 2,rotate = "oblimin", fm = 'ml')
#displays results
fit2

fit2v<-fa(cor_matrix, nfactors = 2,rotate = "varimax", fm = 'ml')
#displays results
fit2v

```
